title: Gene expression analysis in yeast cells
protocol: Collect approximately 2 × 108 cells from exponential growing yeast cultures.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 4000xg at 4°C.
Wash pelleted cells once with cold RNase-free water.
Resuspend cells with 500 μL of LETS buffer.
Add one volume of saturated phenol (pH 4.5) and 200 μL of glass beads.
Break cells in a FastPrep Precellys24 (Bertin technologies).
Centrifuge cell lysate at 13400xg for 5 min at 4°C.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new eppendorf tube.
Add one volume of phenol:chloroform (5:1) to the aqueous phase.
Centrifuge cells at 13400g for 10 min at 4°C.
Repeat steps transferring the aqueous phase and adding phenol:chloroform.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new eppendorf tube after the second centrifugation.
Add one volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the aqueous phase.
Precipitate RNA overnight with one volume of 5 M lithium chloride at -80°C.
Centrifuge cells at 13400xg for 15 min at 4°C after overnight precipitation.
Wash the precipitated RNA with 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge cells at 13400g for 15 min at 4°C to collect the RNA.
Resuspend RNA pellet in 200 μL of RNase-free water.
Re-precipitate RNA overnight by adding Na Acetate (0.3M) and two volumes of ethanol, then storing at -80°C.
Centrifuge cells at 13400g for 15 min at 4°C after re-precipitation.
Wash the precipitated RNA with 70% ethanol again.
Centrifuge cells at 13400xg for 15 min at 4°C to collect the RNA.
Resuspend RNA pellet in 30-50 μL of RNase-free water.
Quantify RNA by measuring absorbance at 260 nm using NanoDrop 2000 Spectrophotometer.
Load 1 μg of RNA on a 1% TAE agarose gel and run electrophoresis for 15 minutes at 120V to check RNA integrity.
Incubate 5 μg of RNA with Turbo DNase for 1 hour at 37°C.
Inactivate DNase by incubating the sample in 15 mM EDTA for 10 minutes at 75°C.
Incubate 1 μg of RNA with 100 pmoles of oligo dT for 5 minutes at 70°C.
Transfer the sample to ice for 10 minutes.
Incubate the sample with Improm-II® Reverse Transcriptase and Recombinant RNasin® following manufacturer instructions: incubate 5 min at 25°C, 60 min at 42°C, and 5 min at 72°C.
Transfer the cDNA to ice.
Analyze cDNA by semiquantitative RT-PCR or quantitative RT-PCR using a DNA Engine Peltier Thermal Cycler with SYBR® Premix Ex TaqTM Tli RNase H Plus Green with ROX.
